name: JellyTag
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language) on media posters and thumbnails
description:
JellyTag automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails: resolution, HDR and Dolby Vision, video codec, audio, language flags and VOST indicator. Badges are rendered server-side and visible on all Jellyfin clients.

Per-panel configuration, SVG and text badge styles, custom badge upload, live preview and library filtering.

versions.changelog:
- Seven more audio badges: FLAC, DTS-HD HRA, DTS, Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital
  Plus, AAC and Opus. Tick them in the Audio panel to show them.
- New "Audio badge source" setting: read the audio badges from the default
  track or from the best of all tracks.
- Badges on item detail pages of the web client (movies, series, seasons and
  episodes), with an on/off switch and a size setting.
- New plugin identity (GUID): this build is installed from its own plugin
  repository and no longer updates from the original catalog. Uninstall the
  original JellyTag before installing it.
